new_identity: New modeling informed by saved reference. Original five fl_* templates remain missing.

pole.placement: position=(0,0.16,0); scale=(1,H-0.16,1), H is desired world hinge height

head.placement: All at (0,H,0), scale=(1,1,1), same quaternion about shared origin
head.tilt: Negative local X rotation points the panel normals downward; yaw is local/world Y
head.physical_attachment: Origin-centered spherical socket overlaps shaft; rear crossbar intersects socket, mounts and both backing plates
head.luminaire: Opaque white diffuser backed by physical slab/frame, two real louvers per panel. No beam geometry or glTF lights.

runtime_budget_scope: Assets only. Two fixed fixtures in both tiers; two full/one low spot receivers are parent runtime responsibilities. No FPS claim.
